dream: Build a small web page called Foundation with three Play-style buttons, side by side. The first shows "Hello, world!". The second shows "My name is Seldon". The third shows "This is the Foundation". Each button and its message is its own independent piece, in its own script file, so the three can be built separately at the same time; a single static page brings them together. No server, no accounts, no dependencies.
